outcomeDefinitions.countsAsOutcome: any arm that produced at least one model-ended turn (stopReason stop or length) and was evaluated. It is scored as-is and never rerun, including a failing one.
outcomeDefinitions.doesNotCountAsOutcome: an arm interrupted by provider quota, authentication failure, or harness launch failure with no model-ended turn and no evaluation. Recorded as an infrastructure abort, kept under its original id, and rerun in full from a fresh task root under a new attempt id.
outcomeDefinitions.lengthStops: stopReason "length" is a model-ended outcome under this preregistration. It is scored, not aborted. This is the existing committed rule and is restated here so v4 cannot silently reclassify it.

variants.infrastructureAbortRule: unchanged from v3: quota/auth/launch failure with no model-ended turn is a rerunnable abort; model-ended attempts (stop, length) are outcomes and are never rerun. The aborted attempt is kept under its own id and listed in results.json excluded[].
variants.stoppingRule: exactly 5 pairs (rep1..rep5), one pair at a time, 2 panes. No retries except under infrastructureAbortRule. No further variant without a new preregistration commit made before that variant runs.

comparisonRule.decisionRule: pairedDiscordance >= +3 -> hand to the governed interpretation step as a candidate-supporting evidence set. |pairedDiscordance| <= 1 -> record the result as inconclusive and hand it to interpretation as such. pairedDiscordance <= -2 -> record as evidence against the candidate claim and hand it to interpretation as such.
comparisonRule.limit: This rule decides only whether the evidence set is coherent enough to hand to a curator. It does NOT set support. A curator record remains the only thing that may classify the claim.
comparisonRule.forbidden: choosing or moving this threshold after inspecting v4 results; rerunning a model-ended arm because the result was inconvenient; pooling aborted batches into the statistic.

runnerRepairs.what: replaced the unbounded `herdr agent wait <pane> --until idle --timeout 2400000` completion detector with a bounded poll of `herdr agent list` status
runnerRepairs.why: `herdr agent wait --until idle` blocked for ~11 minutes in v4 pair 1 treatment although the agent was already idle. This is a harness detector defect, not a model or scoring behaviour.
runnerRepairs.scope: harness completion detection only. Model, effort, prompt, task, fixture, evaluator, exposure method, primary outcome and the comparison rule are unchanged.

runnerRepairs.when: after v4 pair 2, before v4 pair 3
runnerRepairs.what: added the missing `os` import to the inline python in agent_status()
runnerRepairs.why: the pair-1 repair introduced a probe whose inline python used os.environ without importing os, so it always printed `absent` and the completion loop never exited. A second harness defect, found and fixed before any further arm ran.
runnerRepairs.scope: harness completion detection only. Nothing about the model, task, prompt, evaluator, fixture, exposure method, outcome or comparison rule changed.
runnerRepairs.assessment: both v4 harness interventions occurred strictly after the model had ended its turn, and neither touched a scored input. They are recorded here rather than absorbed silently.
